text: I went for a teeth cleaning using social security insurance. I asked via LINE and they said it was reimbursable, but they didn't mention any additional charges on top of the 900 baht. If they had told me beforehand, I wouldn't have minded. It was a total rip-off. I recommend asking all the details before you go. One time was enough.

text: Some of the counter staff provided poor service. I had a dental history, and on the 5th and 6th visits, I asked a lot of questions. However, the staff did not research the information before answering the patient's question, saying that this was the 3rd visit. When I asked further questions, they gave curt answers without any explanation. They only said "no," "no," "no," and "that's it." That's all. I left it at that. I'm moving on.
